citations.narrative:
In November 2025, an approximately 4 month old female wolf pup escaped her enclosure. The bottom of the fenceline
had eroded away and the pup was able to push out and under the fencing. She ran to the neighboring enclosure
containing her dam and tried to enter the enclosure. The licensee found her soon after her escape and placed her in the
dam's enclosure. The pup never left the boundary of the perimeter fence. When enclosures fail to contain animals, it can
lead to injury or death of the animal. Enclosures must be structurally sound and maintained in good repair to protect and
contain the animals. Corrected prior to inspection.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
Additional Inspectors:
Tomeka Manson, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
